linked_process_id.description: Linked process identifier from eLabFTW (do not modify).

analysis_status.description: Status of the AKTA chromatogram analysis.

analysis_timestamp.description: Timestamp when the analysis summary was recorded.

message.description: Human-readable message summarizing the analysis outcome.

n_peaks.description: Number of UV peaks detected in the chromatogram.

retention_times_min.description: List of retention times of detected peaks (minutes).

peak_heights_mau.description: List of peak heights for detected peaks (mAU).

data_files.description: Output data files produced by the AKTA analysis script.

processed_akta_csv.description: Path to akta_processed_{elab_id}.csv file with processed timeseries.

peaks_csv.description: Path to akta_peaks_{elab_id}.csv file with peak summary (if generated).

plots.description: Plot files generated by the AKTA analysis script.

raw_analysis.description: Raw analysis payload loaded from analysis_results_{elab_id}.json.
